techniques.name: Heavy Blow
techniques.description: Your next swing hits a third harder, Might adding more, but is harder to land.

techniques.name: Measured Strike
techniques.description: Your next swing is much easier to land, Dexterity adding more, but does a quarter less damage.

techniques.name: Fighting Retreat
techniques.description: Your next flee in the following ten seconds cannot fail; Reaction holds the opening longer.

techniques.name: Charge
techniques.description: Close on a creature: you walk until it is within six tiles, then dash and strike on arrival, harder and surer than a swing.

techniques.name: Challenge
techniques.description: Creatures fighting party members within three tiles of you turn their blows on you for three rounds, longer with Charm. Does nothing alone.

techniques.name: Second Wind
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Second Wind to use Second Wind.
techniques.description: Recover a tenth of your health plus your Toughness over three rounds. Only in a fight.

techniques.name: War Cry
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of War Cry to use War Cry.
techniques.description: You and party members within five tiles hit harder for thirty seconds, more with Charm. Does nothing alone.

techniques.name: Executioner's Stroke
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Executioner's Stroke to use Executioner's Stroke.
techniques.description: A finisher: against a target under a quarter of its health your next swing does double damage, Might adding more.

techniques.name: Shield Bash
techniques.description: Your next swing is a light blow with the shield that stuns: a creature loses three rounds, a mini-boss two and a boss one.

techniques.name: Brace
techniques.description: A stance. While held you defend better (Toughness adds more), lose half as much for each extra opponent, a blow can do no damage at all, and you deal three tenths less.

techniques.name: Intercept
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Intercept to use Intercept.
techniques.description: For three rounds, creature blows aimed at the party member you choose land on you while you stand within two tiles of them.

techniques.name: Cleave
techniques.description: Your next swing also hits every other creature fighting you within reach, each at reduced damage.

techniques.name: Sunder
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Sunder to use Sunder.
techniques.description: A landed blow strips a tenth of the target's armour for thirty seconds, stacking three times; Perception strips more. The whole party benefits.

techniques.name: Flurry
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Flurry to use Flurry.
techniques.description: Your next round is two quick blows at reduced damage, three with a weapon in each hand.

techniques.name: Hamstring
techniques.description: A landed blow stops a creature taking a step for two rounds, so a shooter cannot back away and a runner cannot run.

techniques.name: Riposte
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Riposte to use Riposte.
techniques.description: A stance. Each blow you dodge is answered with a counter-swing, at most one a round, for two action points each.

techniques.name: Backstab
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Backstab to use Backstab.
techniques.description: With a dagger, from a target's side or back: your next swing is a guaranteed critical that ignores armour.

techniques.name: Lunge
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Lunge to use Lunge.
techniques.description: Strike a creature up to two tiles away before you close in, a little harder than a swing.

techniques.name: Keep at Bay
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Keep at Bay to use Keep at Bay.
techniques.description: A light blow that pushes the target back a tile; a creature short of a boss also loses its next round.

techniques.name: Aimed Shot
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Aimed Shot to use Aimed Shot.
techniques.description: Spend a moment aiming: your next shot is surer and two fifths harder.

techniques.name: Pinning Shot
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Pinning Shot to use Pinning Shot.
techniques.description: A shot that lands stops the creature taking a step for three rounds.

techniques.name: Volley
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Volley to use Volley.
techniques.description: Your next shot also strikes every creature beside the target, an arrow apiece.

techniques.name: Step Back
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Step Back to use Step Back.
techniques.description: Slip out of close combat with no flee roll, backing up to four tiles away from your attackers.

techniques.name: Mark Target
techniques.blocker: Read the Manual of Mark Target to use Mark Target.
techniques.description: A shot that lands marks the creature for thirty seconds: you and your party do a tenth more damage to it.
